caption: The drawing features a single object, a cowbell, centrally positioned against a plain, off-white background. The cowbell is rendered in shades of brown and rusty orange, giving it a weathered, metallic appearance with visible textures that suggest rust and wear. The object is trapezoidal in shape, with slightly curved edges and rounded corners, and it has a rectangular loop handle at the top. Small rivets or fasteners are visible along one of the side edges, and the base of the bell is open and dark inside. The illustration is detailed and realistic, with attention to the worn and tarnished surface of the cowbell, while the background remains entirely unadorned and neutral.
title: Cow Bell
